entries.title: Daniel 7:1
segments: ¶In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream; he told the sum of the matters.

entries.title: Daniel 7:2
segments: Daniel spoke and said, I saw in my vision by night, and behold, the four winds of the heavens broke forth upon the great sea.

entries.title: Daniel 7:3
segments: And four great beasts came up from the sea, different one from another.

entries.title: Daniel 7:4
segments: The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings: I beheld till its wings were plucked; and it was lifted up from the earth, and made to stand upon two feet as a man, and a man's heart was given to it.

entries.title: Daniel 7:5
segments: And behold, another beast, a second, like unto a bear, and it raised up itself on one side; and [it had] three ribs in its mouth between its teeth; and they said thus unto it: Arise, devour much flesh.

entries.title: Daniel 7:6
segments: After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, and it had four wings of a bird upon its back; and the beast had four heads; and dominion was given to it.

entries.title: Daniel 7:7
segments: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold, a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and exceeding strong; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the rest with its feet; and it was different from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

entries.title: Daniel 7:8
segments: I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another, a little horn, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

entries.title: Daniel 7:9
segments: ¶I beheld till thrones were set, and the Ancient of days did sit: his raiment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool; his throne was flames of fire, [and] its wheels burning fire.

entries.title: Daniel 7:10
segments: A stream of fire issued and came forth from before him; thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

entries.title: Daniel 7:11
segments: I beheld therefore, because of the voice of the great words that the horn spoke; I beheld till the beast was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given up to be burned with fire.

entries.title: Daniel 7:12
segments: As for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away; but their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

entries.title: Daniel 7:13
segments: I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of heaven [one] like a son of man, and he came up even to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

entries.title: Daniel 7:14
segments: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all peoples, nations, and languages should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom [that] which shall not be destroyed.

entries.title: Daniel 7:15
segments: ¶As for me Daniel, my spirit was grieved in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

entries.title: Daniel 7:16
segments: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the certainty of all this. And he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things:

entries.title: Daniel 7:17
segments: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, [that] shall arise out of the earth.

entries.title: Daniel 7:18
segments: But the saints of the most high [places] shall receive the kingdom, and they shall possess the kingdom for ever, even to the ages of ages.

entries.title: Daniel 7:19
segments: Then I desired to know the certainty concerning the fourth beast, which was different from them all, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of brass; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the rest with its feet;

entries.title: Daniel 7:20
segments: and concerning the ten horns that were in its head, and the other that came up, and before which three fell: even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth speaking great things, and whose look was more imposing than its fellows.

entries.title: Daniel 7:21
segments: I beheld, and that horn made war with the saints, and prevailed over them;

entries.title: Daniel 7:22
segments: until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most high [places]; and the appointed time arrived, and the saints possessed the kingdom.

entries.title: Daniel 7:23
segments: He said thus: The fourth beast shall be a fourth kingdom upon the earth, which shall be different from all the kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

entries.title: Daniel 7:24
segments: And as to the ten horns, out of this kingdom shall arise ten kings; and another shall arise after them; and he shall be different from the former, and he shall subdue three kings.

entries.title: Daniel 7:25
segments: And he shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most high [places], and think to change seasons and the law; and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and a half time.

entries.title: Daniel 7:26
segments: And the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.

entries.title: Daniel 7:27
segments: But the kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heavens, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most high [places]. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

entries.title: Daniel 7:28
segments: So far is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my countenance was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.
